method: Regularized logistic regression over16 amplitude-invariant channel-min/max features; equal source weight,50 source bootstraps, leave-one-whole-source-out review gates and labelled-noise support rejection.
admission: At least8 source groups and6 groups per class; no held-source programme review candidates; held-source noise coverage>=0.25. Candidate needs fifth-percentile bootstrap score>=0.95 and standardized nearest-noise support distance<=1.5.
uncertainty: Scores and bootstrap bounds are heuristic, not calibrated probabilities or semantic safe-noise guarantees.
finding: No advantage over classical baseline on32 simple fresh synthetic probes. Identical PCM used as desired noise effect and unwanted hiss gets the same review proposal; explicit diagnostic capture attenuates the desired effect9.593dB. No general automatic-capture adoption.
remaining: Adequate real grouped labels, independent source/level/rate/layout shifts and calibrated abstention
